blocks.text: wait for QR code set runtime var [RUNTIME_VAR] to text
blocks.description: Waits until a QR code is detected and stores its text in a runtime variable.

blocks.text: wait for QR code set runtime var [RUNTIME_VAR] to text and broadcast [MESSAGE]
blocks.description: Waits until a QR code is detected, stores its text, and broadcasts a message.
Returns the most recent QR text detected by this extension.
